description: This file defines a custom authentication state provider for a Blazor application, handling user authentication, caching, and fetching user details from a web API.

classes.name: CustomAuthStateProvider
classes.description: A custom implementation of AuthenticationStateProvider that manages user authentication state with caching and user info retrieval from an API.

methods.name: GetAuthenticationStateAsync
methods.description: Overrides the base method to provide the current authentication state, utilizing caching to optimize performance.

methods.name: GetUser
methods.description: Retrieve the user information, either from cache or by fetching from the web API, based on the useCache parameter.

methods.name: FetchUser
methods.description: Fetches user information from the web API and constructs a ClaimsPrincipal based on the response, updating authentication headers.
